- 'mod': Return metadata 'a' raised to the power of 'b' modulo 'm'.
- 'palindrome': Check if the string in metadata 's' reads the same backward as forward.
- 'sort': Return a sorted copy of the list in metadata 'arr'.
Do NOT use external libraries other than math.
